2609.02649.title: Loom: Weaving Diagnostic Strands into Free-Text Consensus via Embedding-Space Reweighting
2609.02649.paper_summary: Aggregating noisy, conflicting textual hypotheses into a reliable consensus is a fundamental challenge when deploying NLP systems in real-world industrial settings. While monolithic Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer unbounded expressivity for tasks like Root Cause Analysis (RCA), they suffer from context limits, compounding hallucinations, and prohibitive inference latency. Traditional weak supervision offers statistical rigor but is mathematically restricted to discrete classes. We present Loom, a generative consensus framework deployed for real-world RCA that bridges these paradigms. Loom aggregates open-form hypotheses emitted by modular heuristics (diagnostic templates dynamically populated with episode-specific entities, times, and metrics) by projecting them into a continuous embedding space, and resolves conflicting signals with an iterative centroid-based reweighting algorithm. The resulting consensus weights ground a single lightweight LLM synthesis step. Evaluated on the OpenRCA benchmark, Loom occupies the accuracy--efficiency Pareto frontier: it matches a state-of-the-art autonomous agent on Bank and Market-2 and trails on Market-1 and Telecom, while using a single LLM call per incident on all four datasets ($\sim$26$\times$ faster; $\sim$33$\times$ with an 8B-parameter synthesizer). We discuss our deployment experience, highlighting lessons learned regarding the trade-offs between agentic depth and inference latency, negative results in redundancy detection, and how deterministic consensus fosters trust among Subject Matter Experts~(SMEs).
2609.02649.paper_summary_zh: 將嘈雜且衝突的文本假設聚合成可靠的共識，是在現實世界工業環境中部署自然語言處理系統的一個基本挑戰。雖然單一的大型語言模型（LLM）代理在根本原因分析（RCA）等任務上提供了無限的表達能力，但它們受到上下文限制、加劇的幻覺以及過高的推理延遲的困擾。傳統的弱監督提供了統計上的嚴謹性，但在數學上僅限於離散類別。我們提出了Loom，一個用於現實世界RCA的生成共識框架，橋接了這些範式。Loom通過將模組化啟發式（動態填充特定事件實體、時間和指標的診斷模板）所發出的開放形式假設投影到連續嵌入空間中來聚合這些假設，並利用迭代的重心基於重加權算法解決衝突信號。最終的共識權重為單一輕量級LLM合成步驟提供了基礎。在OpenRCA基準上進行評估時，Loom位於準確性與效率的Pareto邊界上：在Bank和Market-2上與最先進的自主代理相匹配，而在Market-1和Telecom上略遜一籌，同時在所有四個數據集上每次事件僅使用一次LLM調用（約快26倍；使用8B參數合成器時約快33倍）。我們討論了我們的部署經驗，強調了關於代理深度與推理延遲之間的權衡、冗餘檢測中的負面結果，以及確定性共識如何在主題專家（SMEs）之間促進信任的經驗教訓。
